overview: This resolution, passed by both the House and Senate, tells the Secretary of the Senate to fix the long title of the bill S. 1071 before it is sent to the President. The corrected title describes the bill as authorizing fiscal year 2026 funding for Defense Department military activities, military construction, and Energy Department defense programs, and setting military personnel levels for the year, which is the annual defense policy bill. This kind of correction resolution is used to fix technical errors in a bill after both chambers pass it. It was agreed to on December 17, 2025.
for: Supporters say it is a routine technical fix that ensures the bill's official title accurately describes its contents.
against: Critics say it is a technical correction that doesn't change any law or spending on its own.
